name: Toepen
description: Toepen is a Dutch no-trump last-trick game for 3-8 players. Stakes increase through knocking, which forces fold-or-stay decisions and turns each four-trick hand into a bluffing and risk-management contest.

content.text: Toepen is a Dutch no-trump last-trick game for 3-8 players. Stakes increase through knocking, which forces fold-or-stay decisions and turns each four-trick hand into a bluffing and risk-management contest.
Toepen is a long-standing Dutch social game, often played as a drinking or pub game, and is closely related to German regional forms such as Tuppen and Siwweschroom.
3-8 players in clockwise order; dealer rotates.
32-card deck with rank 10 (high), 9, 8, 7, A, K, Q, J (low). No trumps.
Cards and a life/penalty score tracker.
Dealer gives 4 cards to each player. Player left of dealer leads first trick.

items.text: Fast Drinking Response: After a knock, players fold immediately (simultaneous tempo); hesitation counts as staying in.
Ordered Tournament Response: After a knock, responses proceed in turn starting left of the knocker.
Elimination Continuation: After one player reaches 10 points and drops out, others continue until one player remains.
